title: The Bag Left on the Back Seat
script: Host: [thoughtful] My guest tonight drives for a ride-hailing app, and last month he found himself holding cash most of us would struggle to walk away from. Welcome, Pak Dedi.
Guest: Thank you for having me. I still find it strange being interviewed about something so ordinary to me.
Host: [carefully] Ordinary is exactly the word I want to challenge. Walk us through what happened.
Guest: A passenger left a bag on the back seat after a short trip, and inside it was an envelope stuffed with cash, clearly meant for some kind of payment.
Guest: Eventually, yes, once I'd pulled over somewhere safe. It came to an amount close to two months of my usual income, not a small figure for someone in my line of work.
Host: [honestly] Be honest with our listeners. Did the thought of simply keeping it cross your mind, even briefly?
Guest: Of course it did. I'd be lying if I claimed otherwise, and lying isn't something I want to model for anyone listening.
Host: [gently] What tipped the scale toward returning it?
Guest: Two things, really. First, that money wasn't earned by me, so keeping it would mean building something on a foundation that was never mine to begin with.
Guest: [calmly] Second, I kept picturing whoever it belonged to, panicking, possibly owing that money to someone else, maybe someone far less forgiving than I would have been.
Host: How did you eventually get it back to them?
Guest: [encouraging] The app has a system for this, thankfully. I reported it immediately, and the passenger was traced within a few hours.
Host: Was there a reward offered?
Guest: [seriously] He insisted, practically forced a portion into my hands, but I only accepted enough to cover my fuel that week and nothing more.
Host: Some would call that foolish, leaving money like that on the table.
Guest: Maybe by some counting it is. But by mine, whatever I'd have spent that money on wouldn't have brought me the same peace this decision did.
Host: A generous way to close out our conversation. Thank you, Pak Dedi.
Guest: Thank you for listening, and for treating an ordinary decision as though it mattered.

quiz.question: What did the guest find left in his car?
options: A bag containing an envelope stuffed with cash
A phone
A set of documents
Jewelry
quiz.explanation: A passenger left a bag on the back seat containing an envelope stuffed with cash meant for some kind of payment.

quiz.question: Roughly how much money was it?
options: A few thousand rupiah
Less than one day's earnings
Close to two months of his usual income
Exactly one week's fuel cost
quiz.explanation: He says the amount came to close to two months of his usual income.

quiz.question: What were the two reasons that tipped him toward returning it?
options: Fear of being caught and a company rule
A friend advised him to
He didn't need the money
The money wasn't his to keep, and worry about the owner's situation
quiz.explanation: He explains that the money wasn't earned by him, and he worried about the owner possibly owing it to someone less forgiving.

quiz.question: How did the money get back to the passenger?
options: The guest tracked him down himself
Through the app's reporting system, which traced the passenger within hours
The passenger came back to the same spot
Police intervened
quiz.explanation: He reported it immediately through the app's system, and the passenger was traced within a few hours.

quiz.question: How much of the reward did the guest accept?
options: The full amount offered
Only a small amount, enough to cover his fuel for the week
He refused all of it
Half of what was offered
quiz.explanation: Although the passenger insisted, the guest only accepted a small amount, enough to cover his fuel that week.

quiz.question: What temptation does the driver admit after finding the cash?
options: I usually just say I got up for water, which isn't exactly a lie
The director praised the onboarding redesign in front of the whole department this morning
He briefly considered keeping money worth nearly two months of income.
The trouble is, my team has a standing Monday tradition of ordering food together
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: He briefly considered keeping money worth nearly two months of income.

quiz.question: Which two considerations persuaded him to return the bag?
options: She wakes to pray while the rest of the household sleeps
Dimas isn't even around to see the email
I could have simply said yes, diet
The money was not his, and its owner might urgently need it.
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: The money was not his, and its owner might urgently need it.

quiz.question: How was the passenger located after the discovery?
options: The driver reported the bag through the app's tracing system.
During a stretch of insomnia two years ago
If nobody corrects it, this becomes the version of events everyone quietly accepts
Instead, almost without deciding to, I told the truth, that I was fasting
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: The driver reported the bag through the app's tracing system.

quiz.question: Why did he accept only part of the offered reward?
options: That she mention the habit in their study group to motivate other women
You did plenty of work refining it
What unsettled me wasn't the questions themselves
He accepted enough for fuel without turning honesty into a transaction.
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: He accepted enough for fuel without turning honesty into a transaction.

quiz.question: How should someone handle valuable property found after a ride?
options: She worried sharing it would hollow out something that currently feels entirely hers
I'll just reply privately to the director, thank her
Secure it, report it promptly, and use the platform's return process.
The fasting itself hasn't changed at all
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: Secure it, report it promptly, and use the platform's return process.
